title: Landing at Mos Pelgo
tagline: A new home on a desert world.
description: The game opens in the hold of a cargo freighter. Mom welcomes the player to Mos Pelgo, a moisture-farming settlement on Tatooine, while loader droids carry the furniture in. Dad (Doran) has already gone ahead to run the Mos Entha arena.
lore: Around 2 BBY many families fled the Core after the Empire tightened its grip; the Outer Rim is far from the Emperor's eye.
emerald_description: The game opens inside the moving truck. Mom welcomes the player to Littleroot Town, Vigoroth movers unpack the house, the player sets the wall clock upstairs and watches Dad (Norman, Petalburg Gym Leader) on TV.

title: Meeting the Korr family
description: The player visits the homestead next door, meets Mrs. Korr and goes up to meet Prof. Korr's kid (the rival), who is out surveying companions.
lore: The Korrs are xenobiologists who catalogue Outer Rim companions for a datapad archive.
emerald_description: The player visits the house next door, meets the rival's mother and goes upstairs to meet the rival (May or Brendan, the opposite of the player's choice), who is out helping Prof. Birch with field research.

title: Rescuing Prof. Korr
tagline: A massiff, a field bag and a choice.
description: On the first route Prof. Korr is cornered by a wild MASSIFF. The player grabs a capture pod from his field bag and picks a companion: KATARNKIT, SUNCHICK or MARSHLET.
lore: The three starters come from three different worlds, which is the professor's point: life spreads across the stars.
emerald_description: On Route 101 the player finds Prof. Birch being chased by a wild Zigzagoon. Grabbing a Poké Ball from his bag, the player chooses Treecko, Torchic or Mudkip and wins the first battle. Birch lets the player keep the Pokémon.

title: First rival battle and the datapad
tagline: Your neighbour wants to see what you've got.
description: Korr sends the player to find the rival on Route 103. After their first battle, Korr gives the player the DATAPAD and a first set of capture pods.
lore: The DATAPAD records every companion seen and captured.
emerald_title: First rival battle and the Pokédex
emerald_description: Birch sends the player to find the rival on Route 103. After their first battle, Birch gives the player a Pokédex (the rival gives Poké Balls) and asks them to fill it. Mom gives the Running Shoes; the adventure officially starts.

title: Helping Luke catch a companion
description: At the Mos Entha arena the player meets Dad and Luke, a restless farm boy from the Lars homestead who is heading to Anchorhead. The player helps him catch a AURALET with a borrowed companion.
lore: Luke is about 17 here. Owen keeps him close to home; Obi-Wan watches from a distance.
emerald_description: At Petalburg Gym the player meets Dad and a frail boy, Wally, who is moving to Verdanturf for the cleaner air. Dad lends Wally a Zigzagoon and the player escorts him to Route 102, where he catches a Ralts. Dad says to return with four badges for a Gym battle.

title: The cartel in the Jundland Wastes
tagline: A thug, an engineer and a parts case.
description: In the Jundland Wastes a cartel thug tries to rob an Organa engineer of his schematics. The player drives the thug off.
lore: Jabba's cartel is buying up starship parts across Tatooine. Nobody yet knows why.
emerald_description: In Petalburg Woods a Team Aqua Grunt tries to rob a Devon Corporation researcher of his papers; the player defeats the grunt and the researcher gives a Great Ball.

title: Biggs and the Dune Shard
description: The player defeats Bestine arena leader Biggs Darklighter, a Rock-type specialist who teaches at the Bestine Academy between flight-academy terms, and earns the DUNE SHARD.
lore: Biggs grew up in Anchorhead with Luke, who looks up to him.
emerald_description: The player defeats Rustboro Gym Leader Roxanne, a Rock-type specialist who studies at the Pokémon Trainer's School, earning the Stone Badge and TM39 Rock Tomb.

title: The stolen House Organa parts
tagline: A cartel thug runs for Beggar's Canyon.
description: A cartel thug steals the ORGANA PARTS and flees east into Beggar's Canyon, where he is also holding Han's co-pilot Chewbacca captive. The player gets both back.
lore: Chewbacca is a character, never a companion. His species, the WOOKIEE, is the starter line.
emerald_description: A Team Aqua Grunt steals Devon Goods and flees east through Route 116 into Rusturf Tunnel, taking Peeko, Mr. Briney's Wingull, as a hostage. The player beats the grunt, returns Peeko and recovers the goods.

title: Errands for Senator Organa
description: Senator Bail Organa, visiting House Organa's Bestine office, thanks the player with a COMLINK and asks two favours: carry a MESSAGE DISC to Leia on Kashyyyk, and deliver the ORGANA PARTS to Ric Olié in Mos Eisley.
lore: Bail is quietly funding the early Rebellion through House Organa contracts.
emerald_description: Devon President Mr. Stone thanks the player with a PokéNav and asks for two favours: deliver a Letter to his son Steven in Dewford, and deliver the Devon Goods to Capt. Stern in Slateport. The rival is battled outside (Rustboro).

title: Flying with Han Solo
tagline: Han owes you one for Chewie.
description: Han Solo, grateful for Chewbacca's rescue, flies the player in the Millennium Falcon from his landing pad on Route 104 to Kachirho on Kashyyyk, and later on to Mos Eisley.
lore: This is how planet travel starts: early on Han flies you; later you get hyperlane access of your own (net:hyperlane-travel).
emerald_description: Mr. Briney, grateful for Peeko's rescue, sails the player from his cottage on Route 104 to Dewford Town (and later to Slateport).

title: Tarfful and the Wroshyr Shard
tagline: A dark arena in the roots of a wroshyr tree.
description: The Kachirho arena is a dark maze in the roots of a wroshyr tree, lit a little more with each trainer defeated. Chieftain Tarfful, a Fighting-type master, awards the WROSHYR SHARD.
lore: Tarfful fought beside Yoda in the Clone Wars and knows the Jedi did not betray the Republic.
emerald_description: Dewford Gym is a dark maze lit wider with each trainer defeated. Leader Brawly, a surfer and Fighting-type expert, awards the Knuckle Badge and TM08 Bulk Up.

title: The message for Leia
description: In the Shadowlands the player learns HM05 Flash and finds Leia Organa, who is mapping kyber deposits for the Rebellion. She takes the MESSAGE DISC and gives TM47 Steel Wing.
lore: Leia (about 17) is a junior senator and already a Rebel courier.
emerald_description: The player receives HM05 Flash in Granite Cave and finds Steven Stone, a rare-stone enthusiast, in its deepest chamber. He accepts his father's letter, gives TM47 Steel Wing and registers in the PokéNav.

title: The cartel at the Spacer Museum
description: In Mos Eisley the player delivers the ORGANA PARTS (for a deep-diving bongo sub) to Ric Olié at the Spacer Museum. Cartel thugs led by Boba Fett try to take them; Jabba is seen for the first time.
lore: Boba Fett is a boss you fight, never a companion you catch. He works for Jabba but answers only to the credits.
emerald_title: Team Aqua at the Oceanic Museum
emerald_description: In Slateport the player delivers the Devon Goods (submarine parts) to Capt. Stern at the Oceanic Museum just as Team Aqua grunts try to seize them. Their leader Archie appears, explains Aqua wants to expand the sea for Pokémon, and withdraws.

title: Rival battle on Route 110
tagline: The rival hands over a SCANNER.
description: North of Mos Eisley, below the swoop track, the rival battles the player again and hands over a SCANNER.
emerald_description: North of Slateport, below Cycling Road, the rival battles the player again and hands over the Itemfinder (Dowsing Machine).

title: Luke's first battle
description: In Mos Espa, Luke and Camie's father meet the player; Luke challenges the player with his AURALET. Afterwards he heads to Anchorhead.
lore: Owen worries Luke is 'too much like his father'.
emerald_description: In Mauville, Wally and his uncle meet the player; Wally challenges the player with his Ralts. After losing he resolves to grow stronger and moves on to Verdanturf.

title: Watto and the Spark Shard
description: Arena leader Watto, Mos Espa's grumbling Toydarian junk dealer, awards the SPARK SHARD and TM34 FORCE BOLT.
lore: Watto once owned a slave boy who won the Boonta Eve Classic. He still has the trophy.
emerald_description: Leader Wattson, Mauville's jovial city planner, awards the Dynamo Badge and TM34 Shock Wave. Rydel's Bike Shop gives the player a Mach or Acro Bike.

title: Breaking through Beggar's Canyon
description: With Rock Smash (from a Mos Espa resident) the player clears Beggar's Canyon, reuniting Camie with Fixer, who has been digging through it by hand. The path to Anchorhead opens.
emerald_description: With Rock Smash (from a Mauville resident) the player clears Rusturf Tunnel, reuniting Wanda with her boyfriend and receiving HM04 Strength.

title: The meteorite at Starfall Cavern
tagline: The Empire wants a fallen star.
description: On Sullust, past Inyusu Tor, Imperial stormtroopers corner Dr. Tien in Starfall Cavern and seize his meteorite. The cartel arrives too late to stop them.
lore: Vader's task force is studying the meteorite to find GREATKRAYT, an ancient titan of the deep sands.
emerald_description: Past Fallarbor, Team Magma corners Prof. Cozmo in Meteor Falls and seizes his meteorite. Maxie explains Magma wants to expand the land, then Archie and Team Aqua arrive and Magma heads for Mt. Chimney.

title: Vader at Mustafar Peak
tagline: The first time you face Vader.
description: The player rides the lift up Mustafar Peak, where the Empire and the cartel are fighting. After the player defeats Veers, Darth Vader himself battles the player, retreats, and leaves the meteorite behind.
lore: Vader lets the player go. Something about this child's Force signature unsettles him.
emerald_description: The player rides the cable car up Mt. Chimney, where Team Aqua and Team Magma are fighting. The player defeats Admin Tabitha and Maxie, removing the meteorite from Magma's machine; Maxie retreats and the player keeps the Meteorite.

title: Sabine and the Magma Shard
tagline: A Mandalorian who runs a Fire arena.
description: Hot-springs town Pirin is home to Sabine Wren, a Mandalorian artist and explosives expert who took over the arena from her grandfather. She awards the MAGMA SHARD and TM50 Overheat.
lore: Running the arena is cover for her Rebel work with the Ghost crew.
emerald_description: Hot-springs town Lavaridge is home to Flannery, a new Leader who took over from her grandfather. She awards the Heat Badge and TM50 Overheat. An old woman gives a Wynaut Egg and the rival gives the Go-Goggles needed for the Route 111 desert.

title: Dad's arena: the Balance Shard
tagline: A veteran father, a fair fight.
description: With four shards the player challenges Doran. Winning the BALANCE SHARD and TM42 Facade lets the player use Surf, and Owen Lars thanks the player for helping Luke with HM03 Surf.
lore: Doran served in the Republic navy and left before the Empire rose. He does not say why.
emerald_description: With four badges the player challenges Norman. Winning the Balance Badge and TM42 Facade, the player then receives HM03 Surf from Wally's father, opening the sea routes.

title: The cartel seizes Endor Station
description: On Endor's Route 119 the cartel occupies Endor Station to steal research about the sea titan SANDO. The player defeats Bossk and frees the scientists.
lore: Bossk is a Trandoshan bounty hunter, a person, never a companion.
emerald_title: Team Aqua seizes the Weather Institute
emerald_description: On Route 119 Team Aqua occupies the Weather Institute to steal research about the legendary Pokémon that controls rain. The player defeats Admin Shelly and receives a Castform as thanks.

title: Rival battle and HM Fly
description: Outside Endor Station the rival battles the player and then gives HM02 Fly.
lore: Fly is how the player hops between landing pads they have already visited.
emerald_description: Outside the Weather Institute the rival battles the player and then gives HM02 Fly.

title: The invisible obstacle and the House Organa Scope
description: An invisible TAOZIN blocks the way out of Bright Tree Village. On Route 120 Leia gives the player the ORGANA SCOPE, which reveals it, and the player battles it.
lore: Taozin are invisible to the Force as well as the eye.
emerald_title: The invisible obstacle and the Devon Scope
emerald_description: An invisible Pokémon blocks the way out of Fortree. On Route 120 Steven gives the player the Devon Scope, which reveals Kecleon; once cleared, the path to the Fortree Gym and beyond opens.

title: Chief Chirpa and the Canopy Shard
tagline: An Ewok arena in the treetops.
description: In the treetop village of Bright Tree, Chief Chirpa (Flying-type, glider riders) awards the CANOPY SHARD and TM40 Aerial Ace.
lore: Ewoks have never heard of the Empire. Yet.
emerald_description: In the treetop city of Fortree, Leader Winona awards the Feather Badge and TM40 Aerial Ace.

title: Last rival battle in Cloud City
description: In Cloud City the rival battles the player one last time, then flies home to help Prof. Korr complete the datapad.
emerald_description: In Lilycove City the rival battles the player one last time, then returns home to help Prof. Birch.

title: The kyber of the Jedha Temple
tagline: Two crystals stolen from the Guardians.
description: At the summit of the Jedha Temple, the cartel and the Empire steal the RED KYBER and BLUE KYBER from the Guardians of the Whills, Chirrut and Baze. Chirrut gives the player the CODE CYLINDER to follow the Empire.
lore: The two crystals can command the titans. Jabba takes one, Vader the other.
emerald_description: At the summit of Mt. Pyre, Team Aqua and Team Magma steal the Red Orb and Blue Orb from the elderly couple who guard them. The old woman gives the player the Magma Emblem so they can follow Team Magma.

title: Greatkrayt awakens in Fortress Vader
description: Inside Fortress Vader on Mustafar, the player fights through stormtroopers and Veers but arrives as Vader uses the RED KYBER to wake GREATKRAYT, which vanishes.
emerald_title: Groudon awakens in the Magma Hideout
emerald_description: Inside Mt. Chimney's Magma Hideout, the player fights through grunts and Tabitha but arrives as Maxie awakens Groudon, which vanishes from the lair.

title: The cartel steals the bongo sub
tagline: Boba Fett guards the Hutt Hideout.
description: The player surfs into the Hutt Hideout below Cloud City and defeats Boba Fett, but Jabba escapes in the stolen bongo sub.
emerald_description: The player surfs into Team Aqua's base in Lilycove and defeats Admin Matt, but Archie escapes in Capt. Stern's stolen submarine toward the Seafloor Cavern. The player finds a Master Ball in the hideout.

title: Kanan & Ezra and the Force Shard
description: The two leaders of the Massassi Temple, Kanan Jarrus and his Padawan Ezra Bridger, battle together in a double battle and award the FORCE SHARD and TM04 Calm Mind. The player gains Dive.
lore: Kanan survived Order 66 and trains Ezra in secret, both canon in 2 BBY; the arena is invented.
emerald_title: Tate & Liza and the Mind Badge
emerald_description: The twin Leaders Tate and Liza battle together in a double battle and award the Mind Badge and TM04 Calm Mind.

title: The Empire attacks the launch tower
tagline: A tag battle with Leia against Vader.
description: The Empire storms the Yavin 4 launch tower to steal starship fuel. The player teams up with Leia in a tag battle against Vader and Veers.
lore: Yavin 4 is not yet a Rebel base; Leia is scouting it.
emerald_title: Team Magma attacks the Space Center
emerald_description: Team Magma storms the Mossdeep Space Center to steal rocket fuel for Mt. Chimney. The player and Steven defeat Maxie and Tabitha in a multi battle. Steven then gives HM08 Dive from his house.

title: Sando awakens in the Drowned Cavern
description: Diving off Dagobah's Route 128 the player finds the stolen sub and the Drowned Cavern. After defeating Jabba, Jabba uses the BLUE KYBER to wake SANDO, which flees.
lore: Maxie arrives and both leaders realise they have lost control.
emerald_title: Kyogre awakens in the Seafloor Cavern
emerald_description: Diving on Route 128 the player finds the stolen submarine and Seafloor Cavern. After defeating Shelly and Archie, Archie awakens Kyogre with the Red Orb, which escapes and causes torrential rain across Hoenn, while Groudon causes drought.

title: The titans clash on Dagobah
description: On Dagobah, GREATKRAYT and SANDO battle in the swamp's sunken crater. Leia guides the player; Obi-Wan guards the Cave of Evil.
lore: The constant storm and drought are the titans' doing.
emerald_title: Groudon and Kyogre clash in Sootopolis
emerald_description: In Sootopolis, Groudon and Kyogre battle in the city's crater lake. Steven guides the player to the Cave of Origin where Wallace explains that only the legendary Pokémon of the sky can stop them.

title: Waking the Exogorth at the Asteroid Spire
description: The player climbs the Asteroid Spire (SWOOP BIKE needed for the cracked floors) and wakes the EXOGORTH, which flies to Dagobah and calms both titans.
lore: For Vader this is a flicker of Anakin, not a redemption.
emerald_description: The player climbs Sky Pillar (Mach Bike needed for the cracked floors) and wakes Rayquaza, which flies to Sootopolis and ends the fight. Archie and Maxie admit their mistakes and leave.

title: Yoda and the Swamp Shard
tagline: The smallest leader, the hardest test.
description: With the storm gone, the Dagobah arena reopens. Yoda, Obi-Wan's old master, awards the SWAMP SHARD and TM03 Water Pulse, and the player can use Waterfall.
lore: Rain Badge enables Waterfall outside battle, the gate to Victory Road.
emerald_description: With peace restored, the Sootopolis Gym reopens. Leader Juan, Wallace's mentor, awards the Rain Badge and TM03 Water Pulse; Wallace gives HM07 Waterfall.

title: Luke in the Crystal Caves
description: In Ilum's Crystal Caves Luke, now strong and confident with AURAWARDEN, challenges the player one final time.
emerald_description: At Victory Road Wally, now healthy and strong with Gardevoir, challenges the player one final time before the League.

title: The Four Trials
tagline: Fear, loss, betrayal, the fallen hero.
description: At the Ilum Temple the player faces four Force visions in sequence: Darth Maul (Fear, Dark), Qui-Gon Jinn (Loss, Spirit), Ki-Adi-Mundi (Betrayal, Ice) and Anakin Skywalker (the Fallen Hero, Dragon).
lore: The visions are why a story set in 2 BBY can still include prequel figures.
emerald_description: At the Pokémon League in Ever Grande City the player defeats the Elite Four in sequence: Sidney (Dark), Phoebe (Ghost), Glacia (Ice) and Drake (Dragon).

title: Obi-Wan and the Hall of Fame
description: The player defeats Obi-Wan Kenobi. Prof. Korr and the rival arrive to congratulate them; the team is recorded in the temple's Hall of Fame, and the credits roll as a medal ceremony on Yavin 4.
lore: End of the main story.
emerald_title: Champion Wallace and the Hall of Fame
emerald_description: The player defeats Champion Wallace. Prof. Birch and the rival arrive to congratulate the player, and the team is entered into the Hall of Fame. Credits roll.

title: The Starliner Pass and the roaming Force twins
tagline: Something red and blue on the HoloNet.
description: After the credits the player wakes up at home. A HoloNet report about a mysterious red/blue companion lets the player name it, and ASHLA or BOGAN starts roaming. Dad gives the STARLINER PASS.
emerald_title: The S.S. Ticket and the roaming Eon Pokémon
emerald_description: After the credits the player wakes up at home. A TV report about a mysterious red/blue Pokémon sets Latias or Latios roaming Hoenn. Dad gives the S.S. Ticket, unlocking the S.S. Tidal between Slateport and Lilycove and the Battle Frontier.

title: Lando and the Grand Arena
description: Lando Calrissian, who has been scouting the player since Bestine, invites them to the Grand Arena, where he has hired seven bounty hunters as facility bosses.
emerald_description: Scott, who has been scouting the player since Rustboro, invites them to the Battle Frontier. Seven facilities each have a Frontier Brain (Anabel, Tucker, Spenser, Greta, Noland, Lucy, Brandon) who awards Silver and Gold Symbols.

title: Leia's challenge in Starfall Cavern
description: Using Waterfall in Starfall Cavern the player reaches Leia's hideout and can battle her at full strength.
emerald_description: Using Waterfall in Meteor Falls the player reaches Steven's cave and can battle him at full strength.

title: The Sealed Vault and the Wardens
description: Aurebesh carvings in the Sealed Vault (Route 134, reached with Dive) tell the player to bring certain companions. Doing so opens the tombs of ROCKWARDEN, ICEWARDEN and DURAWARDEN.
lore: The original game uses braille; Aurebesh is the Star Wars equivalent (text swap, same puzzle).
emerald_title: The Sealed Chamber and the Regis
emerald_description: Braille in the Sealed Chamber (Route 134, reached with Dive) instructs the player to have Wailord and Relicanth in the party; doing so opens three tombs: Desert Ruins (Regirock), Island Cave (Regice) and Ancient Tomb (Registeel).

title: The titans return
description: After the Hall of Fame, Endor Station reports abnormal weather pointing to where SANDO and GREATKRAYT are waiting, and the EXOGORTH returns to the Asteroid Spire.
emerald_description: After becoming Champion, the Weather Institute reports abnormal weather pointing to Marine Cave (Kyogre) or Terra Cave (Groudon) appearing on certain routes; Rayquaza can be battled at the top of Sky Pillar.

title: Galactic datapad upgrade
description: With the Outer Rim datapad complete, Prof. Korr upgrades it to the galactic datapad and offers a starter from another sector.
emerald_description: With the Hoenn Pokédex complete, Prof. Birch upgrades it to the National Pokédex and offers Chikorita, Cyndaquil or Totodile.

title: Event worlds
tagline: Passes to places that aren't on any star chart.
description: Event-only key items (TYTHON PASS, WELLSPRING MAP, MORTIS PASS, ATOLLON PASS) shown at the Cloud City port take the player to Tython Isle, the Wellspring, Atollon and Mortis Gate.
lore: Mystery Gift content; the islands exist in the ROM but are unreachable without the event items.
emerald_description: Event-only key items (Eon Ticket, Old Sea Map, Mystic Ticket, Aurora Ticket) shown at Lilycove Harbor take the player to islands with Latias/Latios, Mew, Lugia and Ho-Oh, and Deoxys.
